description: Set an annual funding budget, as the dashboard Budget tab does. Requires budgets:write scope. The tab holds one figure per year, per funding source ('O&M' or 'Capital'), per workspace (module: facilities, infrastructure, or omitted for organization-wide). Send one row per year and funding source - do not split a year across sites or buildings; the tab does not read site_id or building_id and a second row for the same slot is refused with 409. Required: year, funding_source, budgeted_amount.

building_id.description: Building ID. Not read by the Budget tab.

module.description: Workspace the budget belongs to. Omit for an organization-wide budget; set it when the organization budgets facilities and infrastructure separately.

site_id.description: Site ID. Not read by the Budget tab.

name: create_budget
title: Create budget
